pages.text: Nine slots for putting things away for later.

Sneak-click to choose how long (from one day to thirty), then click with a $(item)honeycomb$() to seal it with wax. Until the days are up it will not open, for you or for a hopper. Then the wax gives, and whatever you put away is there again.$(br2)Break a sealed urn early and it $(l)cracks$(): the urn is lost and everything spills out.
